pooled_discrimination_2024_26.interpretation: Fire weather has ~NO skill at WHERE/IF ignitions occur (TX ignitions 84% human-caused; spatial factors dominate). This is expected, and is the quantitative backing for the NEVER-multiply-onto-ignition rule.

within_cell_timing_2024_26.interpretation: The real signal is WHEN/severity: ordinary fire days sit just above a cell's median fire-weather, but the most INTENSE fires (top-1% FRP) concentrate on high-fire-weather days (mean pct 0.63-0.68). TX variant strongest on intensity days, consistent with its large-fire-episode fit target. Fire weather = severity-conditioning layer, not an ignition locator.
